payload.title: Mapping_Data
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook demonstrates how to map paleoclimate data using Pyleoclim, a library for handling paleoclimate data. The notebook groups records into regions as per the original publication and creates a map of these objects. It also saves markers and colors for consistent plotting in future visualizations. The notebook relies on data loaded from a previous notebook and uses a colormap to visually distinguish different regions.
goals: Save markers and colors for plotting consistency

section_blurbs.blurb: The notebook outlines the process of mapping paleoclimate data using Pyleoclim. It involves grouping records into regions, creating a map of these objects, and saving markers and colors for consistent plotting. The notebook imports necessary libraries and loads data from a previously created file.
